decisions.title: Service returns Optional<Student> for the not-found case, not a thrown exception
decisions.rationale: Every existing mutating StudentService method signals not-found via a bare IllegalStateException, which propagates as an opaque 500 — an anti-pattern ADR-0002 flags and story AC #2 forbids for this endpoint. getStudentById returns Optional<Student> (a direct pass-through of studentRepository.findById), and the Controller inspects the Optional to return 200 or 404. This avoids introducing a new exception type or @ControllerAdvice infrastructure for a single endpoint, deferring that to the rule-of-three trigger per reusability-baseline.
